info.description: Websites/channels that can consume shared commerce products, offers, and deals.

thumbnail.description: Screenshot shown on the site card in the dashboard. Decorative only — nothing breaks if it is empty.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the site's repo on the host, e.g. /opt/projects/nxt.bargains. Read-only reference for now; nothing in the CMS executes against it.

deployCommand.description: How this site is published, recorded so the dashboard can say it rather than guess. Not run from the admin — deploys stay on the host.

gaMeasurementId.description: GA4 measurement ID as set in the site's layout.tsx. Unused until traffic metrics are wired in, but recorded here so the mapping lives in one place.

affiliateTags.description: Per-network affiliate identifiers for this site, keyed by network — e.g. { "amazon": "tag-20" }. Never put API secrets here; this is readable by anyone with content access.

contentTypes.description: Which collections belong to this site, keyed by role, each an array because a role can have more than one source: { "posts": [{ "uid": "api::bls-post.bls-post" }] }. An entry may carry a "filter" when a type is shared between sites, as nxtsmart-post is — without it the dashboard counts another site's rows as this one's.
